Aisha (DevEx): Quick sync — final call on SDK + quickstart cutoffs for next drop. Can owners confirm: changelog cutoff, sampleapp readiness, and who will own final smoke?
Ben T: Changelog cutoff I can take. Propose 48h before release candidate. -> I can assemble PR notes (will do by EOD).
Cole (Docs): Docs are mostly in. Need 1 more sample API snippet from Priya for the auth section. Otherwise ready for a minor pass.
Priya (Engineering): Sample apps: main quickstart app passes CI but failing on flaky integration test `tests/e2e/test_init.py` on macOS runners. Investigating.
Aisha (DevEx): Thanks. Ben — can you post the changelog PR and tag owners? Also we need a named smoke owner for release day (1 hour window).
Ben T: Yep. I'll open PR #789 and tag @Priya and @Cole. Smoke owner volunteers?
Priya (Engineering): I can own the smoke for the sampleapp portion. I'll try to fix that flaky test before cutoff; if not, I'll flip it to a skip with a linked issue.
Cole (Docs): I'll own docs smoke and quickstart walkthrough. If Priya skips the flaky test, I'll update the docs note and CI badge.
release-bot: deploy/checklist triggered: `release-candidate/2026-05-11` -> status: queued. See https://ci.internal/release/rc-2026-05-11
Aisha (DevEx): Good. Two action items: Ben opens changelog PR (#789), Priya pushes fix or skip and links issue. Please ack with :white_check_mark: when done so I can close the coordination thread.
Ben T: Done — PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789 :white_check_mark:
Priya (Engineering): Will try fix now, if not done by 1739991000 I'll push skip + issue. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Cole (Docs): Acks. I'll review PR once Ben tags me and leave doc comments. :mag:
Aisha (DevEx): Perfect — keeping this thread as the single source for owners. If anything slips, we escalate to the release lane. Thanks all :raised_hands:
